intro: This rogue trial, issued by Therzok in the Cleft of Shadow, tests initiates seeking entry into the secretive Shattered Hand guild. To prove their deadly efficiency, aspiring rogues are tasked with hunting down the troll smuggler Tazan and seizing his locked satchel.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Warchief is too subtle in his methods. He is cautious to unleash the might of the Horde. Once we were stronger, mighty conquerors all. That pride we must regain, and the Shattered Hand will do so.
We build strength from the shadows and strike at the exposed, secretly laying our enemies low. A task you must complete for me, to prove your worth.
The troll Tazan trades with the pirates near Ratchet. He has information I must have. Kill him and bring me his satchel.

clips.title: Progress
paras: It is a fool who believes a charge with axe drawn is more dangerous than a knife in the dark.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hm, while I am glad to hear that Tazan is no longer with us, a locked satchel does us no good. We need the information kept within.
This should prove a worthy second challenge for one who wishes to join the Shattered Hand.
